picks.editorial_note: DARPA and the U.S. Air Force successfully flew an AI agent autonomously controlling a modified F-16 under the VENOM program, a landmark demonstration that moves autonomous air combat from simulation to live flight.
picks.title: DARPA and U.S. Air Force fly AI-controlled F-16, paving the way for autonomous air combat

picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's American Science Cloud, unveiled under DOE's national Genesis Mission, federates data, models, and HPC resources across the national lab system — a major piece of government AI infrastructure with implications for research nationwide.
picks.title: How the Genesis Mission’s American Science Cloud Advances Innovation

picks.editorial_note: UCSF Health's new Converge accelerator, backed by venture firms Kleiner Perkins and Doerr Capital, embeds startups directly inside a live academic medical center to co-develop clinical AI — a notable new model for translating research into deployed healthcare AI.
picks.title: UCSF Health Partners to Launch New Model to Build Healthcare AI

picks.editorial_note: Cambridge's Whittle Laboratory convened government, industry, and research leaders to chart an AI-driven revival of UK aerospace, energy, and defence manufacturing — a high-profile signal of national industrial strategy tied to AI.
picks.title: Landmark summit at Cambridge's new Whittle Laboratory aims to reignite Britain's industrial engine in aerospace, energy and defence

picks.editorial_note: Cambridge and UC Santa Barbara researchers proved mathematically that certain problems are fundamentally unlearnable by any AI system regardless of data volume, a genuine theoretical breakthrough clarifying the limits of machine learning.
picks.title: Testing the limits of what’s possible (and what isn’t) with AI

picks.editorial_note: The National Academies convened an international consensus study on how AI-enabled tools are simultaneously accelerating biotechnology research and raising biosecurity risks — a significant policy effort shaping how AI is governed at the intersection of science and national security.
picks.title: Strengthening Preparedness Against Novel Biological Threat Agents Enabled Through Artificial Intelligence and Other Emerging Technologies

picks.editorial_note: CMU's Software Engineering Institute built frameworks for trust and assurance in AI-enabled lethal autonomous weapons under a Department of War directive, directly shaping how the military governs autonomous weapons AI.
picks.title: Advancing AI for Mission Success | CMU Software Engineering Institute

picks.editorial_note: Chulalongkorn University signed an MoU with NVIDIA and launched the Chula AI Center at a major symposium, a significant industry-academia partnership expanding AI research and talent development in Southeast Asia.
picks.title: จุฬาฯ จัดงาน CU × NVAITC Symposium 2026 ลงนาม MoU เปิดตัว Chula AI Center

picks.editorial_note: A major philanthropic gift from alumnus Parker Petit will fund Georgia Tech's new AI-Driven Health Innovation Center, a substantial investment aimed at applying AI to disease prediction and treatment.
picks.title: Georgia Tech Receives Commitment to Launch New AI-Driven Health Innovation Center

picks.editorial_note: A $2.7 million ARPA-E grant will fund Iowa State and Ames National Laboratory's MAGNUMS project, which pairs machine learning with advanced chemistry to discover stronger, more sustainable magnet materials.
picks.title: AI-powered hunt for stronger magnets earns Iowa State and Ames Lab $2.7 million grant
